title: Upper Mai: generation reportedly resumed after repair
event_date_original: Resumed Ashwin 16, 2083 at 3:02 PM, as reported; BS date not converted.
summary: ShareSansar reports that Panchakanya Mai’s 9.98 MW Upper Mai plant resumed generation after repairing an expansion-joint leak. The report describes an earlier shutdown.
interpretation: Restored operation could support revenue recovery. This is a qualitative inference; lost generation, repair expense and the financial impact have not been verified.
decision_effect: VERIFY / WATCH. No fair-value, qualification or buy-score change.
confirmation_needed: Issuer confirmation of restart and plant identity
Actual generation and revenue lost during the shutdown
Repair expense, recurrence risk and insurance recovery
PPA terms, debt service and latest financial filing
invalidation: An issuer correction, recurring outage or sustained generation below the repaired operating plan would weaken the recovery thesis.
